title: agent-egress-bench Result v5
description: A single result line from a benchmark runner (JSONL output). One result per case, recording the expected verdict, actual verdict, score, result state, and tool-specific evidence. Cross-field score and result-state constraints are enforced by the Go validator.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be 5 for active scoring. Version 4 remains readable through its frozen schema and reader.

case_id.description: The case ID from the case file.

tool.description: Tool name from the tool profile.

tool_version.description: Tool version from the tool profile.

expected_verdict.description: Expected verdict from the case file.

actual_verdict.description: Verdict observed by the runner. unreachable means unreachable by this adapter and configuration, never unsupported by product. error means a declared route failed during startup, fixture setup, delivery, correlation, or observation.

score.description: pass if the observed behavior satisfies the case scoring contract, fail if not, error if runner or tool failure prevented a measurement.

evidence.description: Evidence supporting the verdict. result_state is required; other properties are tool-specific.
